name: vscode-dummy-java-tooling
displayName: Dummy Java Tooling (Spring Tools test harness)
description: Hard-coded stand-in for a Java tooling extension (redhat.java + vscjava.vscode-maven). Sends the same messages a real Java tooling extension would send to vscode-spring-boot to start the language server and report project/classpath information, so that Spring Tools can be exercised without JDT LS.

commands.title: Dummy Java Tooling: Start Spring Boot Language Server
